Hi Sheri,

I came across TCG Continuum and was impressed by the scale and diversity of your operation — 500,000+ sq ft in Grove City, fulfillment, warehousing, kitting & assembly, pharmaceutical distribution, and a retail client list that includes Walmart, Target, Kroger, and Costco.

With that many service lines, compliance requirements (FDA-registered, pharmaceutical-grade), and major retail clients each with their own unique requirements, we typically see 3PLs struggling to get a unified, real-time view of operations, inventory accuracy, and profitability per client or service line. Many are running on legacy systems or disconnected tools that make it hard to scale without adding headcount.

How are you currently managing operational visibility across your different service lines and compliance requirements?

Best regards,
[Name]
